title: Soft UI component sheet: follow card, video card, product card, toggles, nav, search, progress ring

observed.layout: A canvas of about eight components: (1) follow card with illustrated avatar, name 'Mo zhate', description, pink 'Follow' pill and white 'Cancel' pill; (2) product card 'DBH / 2020 fish skateboard' with description, pink 'Details' pill and two board images; (3) toggles, off (white on white) and on (green track); (4) stat card with a user icon tile, '3,457', 'Follows' label and an avatar row; (5) video card with illustrated thumbnail and play button, pencil '12' and thumbs-up chips, 'Teaching Video', description, a comments field and a rocket button; (6) bottom nav with active 'Home' (pink house icon and label, glow) and inactive light-grey icons; (7) search bar 'Skateboard...' with a blue circular button and glow; (8) pink progress ring.
observed.hierarchy: Pink marks primary action and active state; blue marks search.
observed.typography: Rounded sans; bold card titles, light-grey descriptions. Unconfirmed.
observed.iconography: Line icons with a filled active state; playful illustrated avatars.
observed.materials: Soft, large-radius white surfaces with diffuse shadows and colored glows under pink and blue buttons.

interpretation.aesthetic: Soft, playful UI kit, neumorphic-lite, themed around skateboarding.
implementation_notes: Elevation from layered box-shadows; colored glow shadows under accent buttons.
Toggle via styled checkbox; progress ring via SVG stroke or conic-gradient.
One content theme ties the components into a coherent story.

concept_work.essence: A kit where every component shares one radius, one shadow recipe and one accent, so they assemble into screens.
what_makes_it_work: States shown for the toggle and the nav.
Thematic content makes the set feel like a real product.
gaps_to_make_it_work: Inactive nav icons measure about 1.6:1 against white.
Descriptions and the comments placeholder measure about 1.6-2.0:1.
The 'off' toggle is nearly invisible (white on white).

shared_tokens: hot pink as the single action color
white surfaces on a tinted canvas
links: Follow, Details, nav active and progress ring all use the same pink, so the pink always means 'primary or current'.
Search results would lead to the product card; the nav and search are the entry points to the other components.

approach: Design tokens for radius, shadow and accent
Standard card, toggle, nav and input components

pattern.name: Token-driven component family
use_when: Starting a component library that must look like one product
avoid_when: Strict accessibility targets with pale neutrals
adaptation_examples: Fitness app kit: accent orange, same radii and shadows.
Finance kit: replace glows with borders and raise neutral contrast.

lessons: A shared token set is what makes separate components feel like one system.
Neutral text on pale surfaces is the first thing to fail contrast.

measured.palette_method: Median-cut quantization of the supplied image plus saturated-pixel hue medians. Approximate (JPEG). Items marked 'approx' were judged by eye.
measured.color_roles: Pale canvas with white cards; hot pink for actions and active state; blue only for search; green for the 'on' toggle.
measured.contrast_method: Estimated from compressed images. Background = dominant color in a box around the text. ratio_low = conservative estimate (mean of the most distant ~4% of pixels). ratio = best estimate (mean of the most distant ~1.5% of pixels; for text on a saturated background that appears near-white or near-black, the text is assumed pure white or black, because anti-aliasing of small text otherwise understates the contrast). Accessibility scores use ratio_low; critical failure CF1 uses ratio. Gradient or photo backgrounds are measured one text line at a time. Values within 0.4 of a threshold are borderline and should be verified in the source file.

evidence: A themed kit that covers follow, content, product, settings, navigation and search.
Soft, cohesive look with clear pink focal points.
Common controls are present, but the off toggle lacks an affordance and neutral text is too faint for conventional practice.
Toggle and nav states are shown; input, error and disabled states are not.
Radii, shadows, accent and spacing are tightly consistent across all components.
Conventional components in a pleasant but familiar soft-UI style.
Scored on conservative values: primary text min 3.31:1; secondary text min 1.64:1; icon min 1.57:1; non-color state cue: True.
accessibility.basis: computed from measured contrast + cue flag (scope: contrast and non-color cues only; touch targets, motion and screen-reader support cannot be assessed from a static image)

evaluation.readiness_key: A = ship with minor adjustments (>=80, no critical failure); B = needs specific fixes (60-79); C = rethink (<60)
evaluation.scope: Scored as presented in a static image. States, motion and behavior that are not shown are not scored as present.
